explication: SLiMS 9 Bulian is a library-management system for managing collections, circulation, membership, and related administration. Its main user-facing workflow spans catalog management and discovery, member services, lending and returns, and operational reporting; these are distinct capabilities, not a source-proven sequential pipeline. Staff also administer configuration and stock takes, while API routes expose library-resource controllers. The graph preserves documented capabilities and sampled search-engine internals; many module internals were not excerpted, so their links are limited to README statements or omitted.
